title: Figure 11: Tic Tac parametric velocities vs. event duration (ft/sec)
description: Scatter plot titled "Tic Tac Parametric Velocities for Selected Times of Event Duration (Points are Not Continuous)" with velocity (ft/second, 0 to 140,000) against time (seconds, 0 to 10). Computed velocities fall from about 120,000 ft/s at 0.5 s to roughly 6,000 ft/s at 10 s. The caption reads "Figure 11. Tic Tac Parametric Velocities for Selected Times of Event Duration in ft/sec" (BAASS UAP Analysis Capabilities report, page 35).
